$comment: Schema for the two data files the CPU opponent shares across languages:
* shared/versusAttack.json  garbage rows sent per clear (read by src/versus/garbage.ts AND the
AssemblyScript bot via the generated assembly/bot/generated.ts)
* shared/botWeights.json    evaluator weights (read by src/bot/ AND baked in as the wasm defaults)
ONE declarative description, read by scripts/lib/botData.mjs (generator + tests) and src/bot/botData.ts
(runtime), so neither side can accept a file the other rejects. `features` is the canonical weight order:
it IS the f32 table layout, and the generator emits a W_<NAME> index constant per entry for AssemblyScript.
Add a feature by appending here AND a value in botWeights.json; reordering changes every shipped table.
